book.name: IBRANI
book.title: Nyovara Wao Nanto Vatano Ibrani Mansai IBRANI

content: Syeno Titi Yesus muno Syeno Titi Yahudi

Syeno titi maisyare so: Vatane inta apatimu no vatano Yahudi awa yasyine rai indamu aijaseo syeno titi rai. Umba po anakero syene raijaro kawasae mansai no Amisye amun, maisyare so: arono vatane wo anakotare inta raugav, syeno titi po raunanto Amisye ai, muno po maere rameseo Amisye ai mansamarom indamu Amisye po awa ayao kakaije rapaya.
Syeno titi Yahudi aemeno apa arakove mansai weye taune anuga mayondi maisyare muno apa arakove awa ramaisy. Weti po mansanyao saumambe arono wantatukambe ti wo ayao kakai rave.
Syeno titi taune anuga mayondi wemi mbewar Amisye apa ayao maje indamu syene po anakotare ramero kawasae obo awa ayao kakai rai ramu, yara taune apa ayao kakai rai tavon.

Vatane inta taune po taune aijaseo syeno titi rai omamo mamaisye ramu. Yara Amisye obo pirati po vatane inta awaino anakero syeno titi rai umba mamaisy, maisyare muno Po Harun awaino syene rai no wusyinoe ramaisy.
Maisyare wemaisyamo Yesus Kristus tavon. Kristus opamo taune po taune aijaseo syeno titi rai ramu. Yara Amisye wepirati po aijaseo, Po raura Ai pare:

content.text: muno Risyirati Nya Injaya pi Risy.”

content: Muno Amisye apa daura ti ratoe tavon no anemo kaijinta rai pare,

content.text: “Winyirati nawaino syene raija ntoa nuge nuganui,

content: Arono Yesus no no mine vone so rai, poyov muno Po Amisye awain akoeve Apa sambaya rai, weye Amisye obo pi bambunin Po apaya kakaije rai. Muno Amisye po apa sambaya umaso raraniv weye Yesus beto Ai anuga mpaaje rautan.
Yesus opirati Arikainyo Amisye pije, weramu Apa siurijo nande Ai mo anyao indamu beto Amisye apa bekere rai tenambe.
Muno Apa beto Amisye aije omamo mamai dave, maisyare omai ti Wepirati po kovo nuge nuganuije raugavo vatano nanawirati ubeto Ai mansai tenambe.
Amisye po Yesus awaino Syeno Titi, maisyare Melkisedek wusyinoe amaisy.
Vemo wasakirive Amisye ai nora, muno wapo wapa anave rapaya ntami nora

Sya arakove, ribeker syare syo anakotar manui inta raura wasai indamu ananyao Yesus muno Melkisedek umaso mbaro wasai. Weramu syo raura kakavimbe wasai omamo nsosobe rave, weye wapa ana wadatantona mamo mavave da nanto rai ramu.

Abo! Weapamo wapanave Amisye ai nugoenta to, weti syo rakarae weabe kurumbe wapo Apa ananyao raugaje mamo ama masyote mi so nto. Weramu tugae mamo syo wasaenamo wamaisyare arikainyo tuvanoe! Weti kove mamo vatane wo wasanyao Amisye apa ayao rai jakato rati, indamu Apa ananyao moto manasyine, jirume, mandeije wapo ranaun dijati. Weapamo wasaurata irati arikainyo tuvane inta ai, wepirati po anaisyo paparaisy rai dainy, yara po ukame obo raisya nene amaisy.
Vatano po ukame raisye pamo arikainyo tuvane pa, ti pantatukambe pare kakai mi rui muno kove mi rui?

Weramu anaisyo paparaisye mamo vatano apa akoe matu to wepi po raisy. Vatane so aurata irati vatano awa anave matu to. Onawamo wo ananyao tugae ratantona tutir, muno wo taune manuga raeranande indamu mbambunin. Weti wo kakai, kove raen.
